attributes.board_name: North Carolina Board of Occupational Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: Activities sponsored/approved by NCOTA, AOTA or AOTA-approved providers and other qualified activities in Rule .0805: continuing education incl. live, web-based and formal self-study with assessment (1 point per contact hour, no maximum); academic coursework (1 point per contact hour, max 6, unlimited for graduate OT students); small group study (1 point per 3 h, capped); publications (e.g. 15 points for a book); board/specialty certification (15 points) and others. Not accepted: new-employee orientation and employer-required annual training; the same activity only once per period.
rules.audit_note: Activities are entered in the Board's online CCA tracker (July 1 – March 30) or during online renewal (April 1 – June 30). Random audit at least once each licensing period; keep documentation 2 years after the renewal period; do not send it unless audited.

topics.who: At least 1 contact hour on ethics in OT practice each renewal period, entered under the 'Ethics' category; counts toward the 15 points

rules.notes: Annual renewal; points earned July 1 of the preceding year through June 30 of the current year. For continuing education, 1 point = 1 contact hour awarded by the provider.
rules.rule_quote: (a) Licensed occupational therapists and occupational therapy assistants applying for license renewal shall document having earned a minimum of 15 points for approved continuing competence activities between July 1 of the preceding year and June 30 of the current year.
